files.README.md:
# Fenlock Growers - arable blocks

Shared folder for the agronomy team.

- blocks/  cards for each field block
- soil/  sampling notes from the laboratory

turns.prompt: A new agronomist at Fenlock Growers asked what the analysis figure on a fertiliser card means; the first number of a grade is the share of the product's mass that is the nutrient. Block 64 is planned at 240 kilograms per hectare of a product analysed at 27 percent nitrogen, across 12.5 hectares. Give the nitrogen those hectares receive, in kilograms.
